title: Make Team Chat obvious
summary: Makes group messaging easier to understand at a glance and repairs the mobile composer so it reads as one clear control instead of nested glass rings.
changes: The Chat inbox now labels Anaesthetic Team plainly as Team chat, explains that it reaches everyone on tonight’s roster, uses team-member wording, and gives New private chat a visible text label.
The staff-coordination notice is shorter and no longer repeats the 14-day retention message, while notification settings are visually quieter beneath the conversations.
Team and private composers now use one glass dock with a plain text field and one send button, clearer placeholder text, cleaner spacing above the tab bar, and no duplicate borders or glow rings.
